nina_csm: Heads-up: Triton Labs (enterprise) seeing p95 jitter and 30% higher token cost than expected during peak nightly batches. Renewal review in 2.5 weeks. Want a low-risk perf plan that preserves QA for legal summaries. Propose: compact quant canary for non-critical flows + route batch jobs to cheaper region + cache warmup. Thoughts?

omar_cs: flagged. Customer tolerance: zero visible regression on legal summaries. Background flows (helpdesk, notifications) ok to test. Need acceptance criteria: p95 critical <= 200ms, net cost delta >= 18%.

kai_eng: feasible. Plan: 1) spin compact-7b-4bit as canary for background routes at 10% for 24h; 2) add region split for batch to eu-central; 3) pre-warm prefix cache for common doc prefixes. Expect ~25% cost reduction on canary traffic, slight cold-start p95 initially.

dana_sre: SRE guardrails: rollback on error_rate>0.5% or hallucination_delta>0.8% absolute in 30m window. Instrument per-route p95, kv_hit_ratio, and token_ms. Also add tracing to prove cache effect.

rollout-bot: Canary initiated: triton-compact-7b-4bit (10% traffic)  pods 2->5, region: eu-central. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/triton-compact-7b-4bit

nina_csm: Customer asks for a blind A/B with redacted prompts before we ramp. Can we produce a 30-prompt deck and automated metrics?

kai_eng: yes. Will produce deck and run `./evals/run --left redwood/13b-v2 --right redwood/7b-4bit --suite triton_ab.json --metrics rouge,bert,halluc`. Results to Drive within 6h.

omar_cs: I'll coordinate enablement call and legal sign-off for prompt redaction. Schedule tentatively Wed 11am PT.

dana_sre: I'll watch first 2 hours and page on threshold. Also will snapshot per-region cost during canary.

nina_csm: great. I'll post customer feedback after 24h and update renewal notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
